name: navigation/breadcrumb-trail
title: Breadcrumb trail
description: The path to the current page, folding its middle when space runs out.

files.content:
export { BreadcrumbTrail, crumbsToHide } from './BreadcrumbTrail';
export type { BreadcrumbTrailProps, Crumb } from './BreadcrumbTrail';

keyboard.action: Move between crumbs and the fold button.
Follow a crumb, or open and close the folded levels.
Close the folded levels and return focus to the fold button.

notes: A `nav` landmark with an accessible name, containing an ordered list of links.
The current page link has `aria-current="page"` and is marked by weight and a shape, not colour alone.
The fold button names how many levels it hides and exposes `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
The folded list closes on Escape, on a click outside, and when focus leaves it.
Separators are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.reducedMotion: New crumbs and the folded list appear without sliding.
